review.why: Explains attribution models and measurement approaches and how to reconcile conflicting numbers from ad platforms, analytics and CRM.
review.summary: Two tracks. Interpretation: models and how each misleads, multi-touch versus mix modeling versus incrementality, self-reported attribution, reconciling sources and blind spots such as direct and dark social. Build: identity merge, stitching on third-party domains, guardrails and CRM sync. It ends with a readout template and a rule never to sum conversions across platforms.
strengths: Counts real conversions once against a single source of truth
Shows each model next to how it misleads
Anonymity guard: fails closed so personal ids never reach third-party URLs
cautions: The build track needs engineering work and specific tools
Four reference files hold the model math and playbooks and are not read here
Platform minimums it quotes can change
